## Decisions

- `kb:adr/actions-placement-mainhead-and-card-rows` — End, Resume and Remove live in a mainhead above the focused terminal and in hover-revealed action rows on rail cards and tile footers, behind confirm dialogs. (accepted, 2026-08-27; features: actions, focus, rail, tiles) → `docs/adr/actions-placement-mainhead-and-card-rows.md`
- `kb:adr/surfaces-one-live-client-per-session` — A session is live on exactly one surface at one geometry at a time; every other rendering of it is a static snapshot. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: surfaces, tiles, rail) → `docs/adr/surfaces-one-live-client-per-session.md`
- `kb:adr/tiles-drag-reorder-header-handle-insert-shift` — Tiles reorder by dragging the tile header only; a drop on another tile inserts and shifts, never swaps, with neutral feedback and no daemon involvement. (accepted, 2026-08-29; features: tiles) → `docs/adr/tiles-drag-reorder-header-handle-insert-shift.md`
- `kb:adr/tiles-launched-session-promoted-into-grid` — A session launched from Tiles is promoted into the live grid, demoting the lowest-priority tile when full, rather than admitted only if a slot is free. (accepted, 2026-08-30; features: tiles, launch) → `docs/adr/tiles-launched-session-promoted-into-grid.md`
- `kb:adr/tiles-new-session-button-in-toolbar` — Tiles gets its own New session button in the density toolbar, opening the shared launch dialog; a plus pseudo-tile in the grid was rejected. (accepted, 2026-08-30; features: tiles, launch) → `docs/adr/tiles-new-session-button-in-toolbar.md`
- `kb:adr/tiles-order-ephemeral-per-window` — Tile order is per-window and ephemeral, held with grid membership in client state; nothing is persisted and the protocol is untouched. (accepted, 2026-08-29; features: tiles) → `docs/adr/tiles-order-ephemeral-per-window.md`
- `kb:adr/tiles-slot-stable-grid-never-self-sorts` — The Tiles grid never re-sorts itself by attention: a promoted session takes the demoted tile's slot, survivors keep their order, only the user reorders. (accepted, 2026-08-29; features: tiles) → `docs/adr/tiles-slot-stable-grid-never-self-sorts.md`
- `kb:adr/tiles-sticky-live-membership` — Tiles grid membership is computed at view entry and density change only; afterwards only user action changes it, so a terminal never vanishes mid-keystroke. (accepted, 2026-08-23; features: tiles) → `docs/adr/tiles-sticky-live-membership.md`
- `kb:adr/views-focus-and-tiles-peers` — The dashboard has two peer views, Focus and Tiles, switched from the masthead or a chord, with the choice persisted daemon-side. (accepted, 2026-08-16; features: views, focus, tiles) → `docs/adr/views-focus-and-tiles-peers.md`

## Retired, rejected and superseded

- `kb:adr/theme-no-traffic-light-state-palette` — A green, orange and red traffic-light palette for the tile state dot was not adopted; state colours come only from the design system's state tokens. (rejected, 2026-08-29; features: tiles, theme) → `docs/adr/theme-no-traffic-light-state-palette.md`
- `kb:adr/tiles-live-top-n-snapshot-rest` — In Tiles the live grid holds the top N sessions by attention and every other session is a snapshot card; density sets N and every tile's geometry. (superseded, 2026-08-16; features: tiles) → `docs/adr/tiles-live-top-n-snapshot-rest.md`
